name: worth-attention
description: Is one item worth an agentic engineer's attention today

worth.instructions: Is the item in `title` and `excerpt` worth the attention of an engineer who builds with AI agents, today? `taste_examples` lists items the reader liked or disliked.

criteria.true: A new release, finding, technique, change or credible analysis that could change what an agentic engineer builds or knows
criteria.false: A rehash, listicle, marketing, rumor, minor update, or off topic for agentic engineering

novelty.instructions: How new is the information in `title` and `excerpt`?
